items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I never did see that record anywhere in the states... He was with me a good while. Al was pretty nice and when he left the band...

ctx.x: So anyway, we went into New York and we met him in Jersey, the Regal Company, and we did an original, a couple of us got together and the band jammed around and we did a

number, an instrumental number featuring Cooper on baritone sax, and it went so well and everything, they were just tickled, we released it and Chambers--did you ever know Chambers the trombone player?
